definitions.explanation: A natural spring of geothermally heated water, or a resort/facility built around such a spring.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}に{温泉|おんせん}に{行|い}く{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: I plan to go to a hot spring on the weekend.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}には{温泉|おんせん}がたくさんある。
examples.english: There are many hot springs in Japan.

examples.japanese: {温泉|おんせん}に{入|はい}ると{疲|つか}れが{取|と}れる。
examples.english: Taking a hot spring bath relieves fatigue.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE: {温泉|おんせん} is deeply ingrained in Japanese culture. Japan has over 3,000 hot spring resorts due to its volcanic geography.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{温泉|おんせん}に{入|はい}る (to take a hot spring bath)
・{温泉|おんせん}に{行|い}く (to go to a hot spring/spa)
・{温泉|おんせん}{旅行|りょこう} (hot spring trip)
・{温泉|おんせん}{地|ち} (hot spring resort area)
・{温泉|おんせん}{宿|やど}/{旅館|りょかん} (hot spring inn)

TYPES OF {温泉|おんせん}:
・{露天風呂|ろてんぶろ} (outdoor bath)
・{内湯|うちゆ} (indoor bath)
・{足湯|あしゆ} (foot bath)

FAMOUS {温泉|おんせん} AREAS:
・{別府|べっぷ}, {箱根|はこね}, {草津|くさつ}, {有馬|ありま}
